WHERE IT STARTED

A LIFETIME BEHIND THE KIT

I started playing and having lessons at just six years old, joining Berkshire Rock & Pop School at seven. Music was part of my life from the beginning. My Dad was a well-known guitarist, and I was fortunate to tour with him from a young age and later work alongside him. I also learnt drumming from Bret Morgan, who had an important influence on my development. Those early experiences grew into a professional career spanning recordings, live gigs, studio work and shows, including Top 10 chart work and a Christmas number one.

02 / PRIVATE TUITION · SCHOOL GROUP SESSIONS · TAILORED WORKSHOPS

PRIVATE TUITION, SCHOOL GROUP SESSIONS & WORKSHOPS

FROM FIRST BEATS TO LIVE PLAYING

Whether you're picking up drumsticks for the first time or developing existing skills, I design lessons to be enjoyable, practical and rewarding.

Drum technique, timing, rhythm, coordination, reading music, playing along with songs, click tracks and backing tracks are covered. I aim to provide confidence behind the kit and skills for live playing.

Practice between lessons has a purpose. I set homework around your individual development needs and, wherever possible, music that appeals to you. We then review your progress at the next lesson and build from there.
